$comment: Meta Ads Expert V2 — clean strategy contract. This describes BUSINESS DECISIONS the LLM makes (goal, objective, audience, budget, creative direction) — never raw Meta ids and never Meta's own low-level API shapes. Asset fields (ad_account/facebook_page/pixel/catalog/instagram_identity) are SEMANTIC references only (e.g. "default_ad_account", or a real id the user already explicitly confirmed this conversation) — resolving them to trusted raw ids is strategyBuilder.js/assetResolution.js's job, never the LLM's. See strategySchema.js for the code that enforces this.

business_goal.description: The user's own stated goal, in their words.

goal_alignment.description: Deterministic pre-strategy reasoning, required whenever the literal request and the likely real business outcome could differ (Step 4's traffic-vs-sales case). Optional when there's no real tension (e.g. the user already said 'sales').

audience_strategy.description: What the proposed audience was actually derived from — the evidence basis, not the targeting mechanism (see targeting_approach for that). HEURISTIC is only honest when no real store/account data exists.

audience_reasoning.description: Required only when the audience is fully generic (ALL genders, 18-65) — a short, honest reason no narrower targeting applies.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes — what real Meta targeting is actually built from.

budget_daily.description: In the ad account's currency's smallest unit. Null if a budget policy/user input is still needed — never invent a number.

evidence_used.description: Concrete, specific facts actually pulled from the business snapshot that this strategy is based on (e.g. "WooCommerce: 42 products in Skincare, avg price PKR 1,800", "Meta history: 3 campaigns, avg ROAS 2.1") — never a vague restatement. Evidence Rule (Step 12): only cite what get_business_snapshot actually returned.

unresolved_questions.description: Genuine unresolved BUSINESS decisions only — never a technical/asset question (those are resolved automatically by the backend). Empty (or omitted) for a fully-resolved strategy.

action_type.description: Only relevant when mode is "explicit_action" — which fixed, lightweight action the user asked for (e.g. 'boost my latest reel').

content_selector.description: Only relevant when mode is "explicit_action". Refers to content ORDINALLY (e.g. { position: 1 } = the most recent item in the snapshot's recentContent list the LLM already saw) or by a real id ONLY if it was already confirmed via get_business_snapshot this conversation — never invented. Never a raw id the LLM is guessing at.

attachedMediaRef.description: A chat-attached image/video reference id, when action_type is USE_ATTACHED_IMAGE/USE_ATTACHED_VIDEO.
